topic.source_contract: Shoreline Management Plans, coastal erosion risk, CCMAs, adaptation and defence evidence

facts.coverage: 20 living SMPs cover the English coast to 2105
facts.guard: management approach depends on funding and is not a site defence guarantee

facts.collection: current coastal risk, planning, modelling, adaptation and environment guidance
facts.guard: collection links must be resolved to current local evidence

facts.policy: avoid inappropriate development in vulnerable coastal areas and support adaptation
facts.guard: national policy is not a parcel-level erosion forecast

facts.planning: Coastal Change Management Areas and vulnerability/use-lifetime evidence
facts.guard: CCMA designation and exception tests require local-plan and application evidence

facts.living_plan: approaches and actions can change with new evidence
facts.guard: historic SMP text must not override current approved changes

scope_guards: An SMP management approach is not treated as a funded defence commitment.
Historic SMP policy is not used without checking approved updates.
Coastal flood and coastal erosion risks are kept separate.
A defence asset is not treated as effective for a development lifetime without evidence.
A CCMA is not inferred from proximity to the coast.
Erosion forecasts retain epoch and uncertainty.
Adaptation policy is not treated as delivered relocation or protection.
No score or promotion is written without exact parcel, policy unit, epoch, CCMA, asset, funding and planning evidence.
